title: Latent-Lens: Visual Perception in Small Language Models Through Latent Communication
title_zh: Latent-Lens：通过潜空间通信实现小语言模型中的视觉感知

paragraphs.en: Bridging independent vision-language models (VLMs) and small language models (SLMs) in a modular multi-agent system typically forces them to exchange information as discrete text, which creates a lossy bottleneck for spatial and fine-grained details. This constraint is especially acute for SLMs, whose limited capacity makes them more reliant on the quality of the input signal. Recent latent-communication methods exchange states between language models. How a VLM can pass visual information to a separately pretrained text-only SLM though remains unexplored. We propose Latent-Lens , a lightweight codec that bridges the representation gap between a frozen VLM and a frozen SLM directly in latent space, enabling them to communicate purely through hidden states. The codec consists of a domain encoder that projects hidden states from the VLM into the SLM’s embedding space, and an attention decoder formalised as a LoRA that teaches the SLM to attend to these visual prefixes, while training only ∼ 1.6 {\sim}1.6 M parameters (0.2% of the combined model size). On visual question answering (CLEVR, GQA), Latent-Lens achieves 81.0 ± 7.9 81.0\pm 7.9 % and 65.4 ± 5.4 65.4\pm 5.4 %, compared with 58.3 ± 5.7 58.3\pm 5.7 % and 61.8 ± 1.0 61.8\pm 1.0 % for text communication with the same LoRA budget (+30.2–69.8pp relative to frozen text communication), while on image captioning (Flickr8k) it improves over the same baseline by +16.5 (+18.8 frozen). We also evaluate Latent-Lens with TinyLlama-1.1B and InternVL2-1B, which use different architectures, vocabularies, and hidden dimensions.

paragraphs.en: Small language models (SLMs) are increasingly deployed on-device and at the edge, where compute and memory budgets can preclude accommodating a monolithic vision-language model (VLM), leaving these systems without visual perception. Tightly coupled VLMs such as LLaVA ( Liu et al., 2023 ) and Qwen-VL ( Bai et al., 2023 ) fuse visual and linguistic representations within a single end-to-end trained system. While effective, this tight coupling is inflexible. Upgrading the vision encoder or the language model requires retraining the entire system, and scaling such VLMs down to fit on-device budgets often degrades visual capabilities disproportionately. For example, TinyLLaVA ( Zhou et al., 2024 ) reports substantial benchmark drops below 1B parameters. Multi-agent approaches offer modularity by pairing a small VLM with a SLM, but have so far relied on text-based communication ( Du et al., 2024 ) . However, text constitutes a lossy channel. Spatial layouts and fine-grained visual attributes are difficult to verbalise faithfully. SLMs amplify this loss, since with little parametric capacity to fall back on they have no reliable way to recover details the text channel has already discarded. For instance, BeMyEyes ( Huang and others, 2025 ) pairs a VLM with a large proprietary LLM through text conversation, but even with substantially more capable models, the generated descriptions inevitably discard fine-grained spatial and visual details.
paragraphs.zh: 小型语言模型越来越多地被部署在设备端和边缘侧，在这些场景下，算力和内存预算可能无法容纳一个大型的视觉-语言模型，导致这些系统缺乏视觉感知能力。 紧耦合的视觉-语言模型，如 LLaVA（Liu et al., 2023）和 Qwen-VL（Bai et al., 2023），在单一端到端训练的系统内部融合视觉与语言表征。 这种紧耦合虽然有效，但缺乏灵活性。 升级视觉编码器或语言模型都需要重新训练整个系统，而将此类视觉-语言模型缩减以适配设备端预算时，视觉能力往往会不成比例地大幅下降。 例如，TinyLLaVA（Zhou et al., 2024）报告称，参数量低于 1B 时基准成绩会显著下滑。 多智能体方法通过将一个小型视觉-语言模型与一个小型语言模型配对来提供模块化，但迄今都依赖基于文本的通信（Du et al., 2024）。 然而，文本是一种有损的通道。 空间布局和细粒度的视觉属性难以被忠实地用语言表达。 小型语言模型会放大这种损失，因为它们几乎没有可供依赖的参数容量，无法可靠地恢复文本通道已经丢弃的细节。 例如，BeMyEyes（Huang and others, 2025）通过文本对话将一个视觉-语言模型与一个大型的专有语言模型配对，但即便使用了能力强大得多的模型，生成的描述也不可避免地丢弃了细粒度的空间与视觉细节。

paragraphs.en: We propose Latent-Lens , a lightweight, model-agnostic codec that bridges the representation gap between a frozen VLM and a frozen SLM, allowing them to communicate directly in latent space and thus bypass the lossy text bottleneck. In contrast to discrete text descriptions (as in BeMyEyes ( Huang and others, 2025 ) ), our method transmits rich, uncompressed visual representations directly. By extracting multiband latent prefixes, our approach enables cross-modal perception while preserving the depth-wise hierarchy of features encoded across the VLM’s layers.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 Latent-Lens，一个轻量级、模型无关的编解码器，它弥合了冻结的视觉语言模型与冻结的小型语言模型之间的表示鸿沟，使二者能够直接在潜空间中通信，从而绕过有损的文本瓶颈。 与离散的文本描述（如 BeMyEyes（Huang 等，2025））不同，我们的方法直接传输丰富且未压缩的视觉表示。 通过提取多频带潜前缀，我们的方法在实现跨模态感知的同时，保留了在视觉语言模型各层中编码的特征的深度层级结构。

paragraphs.en: Latent-Lens consists of two functionally distinct components, jointly trained end-to-end. The first is a lightweight MLP domain encoder that extracts and projects hidden states from three semantic bands of the frozen VLM. The second is an attention decoder, instantiated as LoRA adapters on the frozen SLM’s attention projections, that teaches the SLM to attend to these projected prefix tokens. We evaluate Latent-Lens with two SLMs, Qwen2.5-0.5B (896-dim ( Alibaba Cloud, 2024 ) ) and TinyLlama-1.1B (2048-dim ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) ), and two small VLMs, SmolVLM-256M (576-dim ( HuggingFace, 2024 ) ) and InternVL2-1B (896-dim ( Chen et al., 2024 ) ), to demonstrate generality across different families of models. Only 1.6-6.1M parameters are trained per pair, representing less than 1% of the combined frozen parameters in all cases.
paragraphs.zh: Latent-Lens 由两个功能上不同的组件构成，并进行端到端联合训练。 第一个是轻量级的 MLP 域编码器，它从冻结 VLM 的三个语义频带中提取并投影隐藏状态。 第二个是注意力解码器，以 LoRA 适配器的形式实例化在冻结 SLM 的注意力投影上，教会 SLM 关注这些投影出的前缀词元。 我们使用两个 SLM（Qwen2.5-0.5B（896 维（Alibaba Cloud, 2024））和 TinyLlama-1.1B（2048 维（Zhang et al., 2024）））以及两个小型 VLM（SmolVLM-256M（576 维（HuggingFace, 2024））和 InternVL2-1B（896 维（Chen et al., 2024）））来评估 Latent-Lens，以展示其在不同模型家族上的通用性。 每个模型对仅训练 1.6-6.1M 参数，在所有情况下均不到冻结参数总量的 1%。

paragraphs.en: Multi-agent systems built from independently trained components most commonly exchange information through natural language. Du et al. (2024) show that multi-round text debate among LLM instances improves factuality and reasoning. Liang et al. (2024) extend this by encouraging divergent thinking across agents to enhance answer diversity, and ChatDev ( Qian et al., 2024 ) applies text-based conversation to coordinate specialised models for software development. paragraphs.en: An alternative to text is to communicate directly through hidden states, motivated by the observation that natural language is structurally misaligned with LLMs’ high-dimensional representations and causes irreversible information compression ( Zhou et al., 2025 ) . In line with this, Yue and others (2025) show that 28-73% of text-based inter-agent communication is redundant. The idea originated in multi-agent reinforcement learning. DIAL ( Foerster et al., 2016 ) introduced differentiable inter-agent messaging, instantiated by CommNet ( Sukhbaatar et al., 2016 ) as a mean-pooled hidden-state channel. Subsequent work introduced selectivity over the channel via attention-based targeting in TarMAC ( Das et al., 2019 ) and learnable gating in IC3Net ( Singh et al., 2019 ) , and structured topologies via relational graphs ( Jiang et al., 2019 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 除文本之外的另一种方式是直接通过隐藏状态进行通信，其动机在于观察到自然语言在结构上与LLM的高维表示不对齐，并导致不可逆的信息压缩（Zhou et al., 2025）。 与此相呼应，Yue等人（2025）的研究表明，基于文本的智能体间通信中有28%至73%是冗余的。 这一思想起源于多智能体强化学习。 DIAL（Foerster et al., 2016）提出了可微分的智能体间消息传递，并由CommNet（Sukhbaatar et al., 2016）实例化为一种均值池化的隐藏状态通道。 后续工作在通道上引入了选择性机制，包括TarMAC（Das et al., 2019）中基于注意力的定向发送和IC3Net（Singh et al., 2019）中可学习的门控，并通过关系图引入了结构化拓扑（Jiang et al., 2019）。

paragraphs.en: More recently, the principle has been applied to transfer representations between frozen language models. LatentMAS ( Zou et al., 2025 ) shares last-layer hidden embeddings through a latent working memory between identical LLMs, achieving up to 14.6% accuracy gains with lower latency than text debate, and ThoughtComm ( Zheng et al., 2025 ) provides identifiability guarantees for such latent thought exchange. A further line of work targets heterogeneous LLMs with different architectures and vocabularies: Interlat ( Du et al., 2025 ) learns compression adapters across architectures for a substantial inference speedup, C2C ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) fuses KV caches across Qwen, Llama, and Gemma via learned gating, and Dery et al. (2026) learn KV-cache alignment adapters in the same spirit, SDE ( Tang et al., 2025 ) takes a hybrid stance, augmenting text with hidden-state deltas, and Vision Wormhole ( Liu and others, 2026 ) communicates reasoning traces between VLMs through the receiver’s visual-token pathway. None of these methods address transfer from a VLM to a text-only SLM, which is the setting studied here. Moreover, these methods do not use the sender’s depth hierarchy as a structured signal. Hidden-state methods exchange a single transformer layer, while KV-cache methods span all layers but pool or align them uniformly rather than separating depth-wise abstraction levels. Finally, although multi-depth structure has been explored within a single model - e.g., LLaMA-Adapter ( Zhang et al., 2023 ) inserts gated visual residuals at several transformer depths of one VLM - multi-depth transfer across two separate models is unexplored.
paragraphs.zh: 最近，该原理已被应用于在冻结的语言模型之间迁移表示。 LatentMAAS（Zou et al., 2025）在相同的LLM之间通过潜在工作记忆共享最后一层的隐藏嵌入，与文本辩论相比以更低的延迟实现了高达14.6%的准确率提升，而ThoughtComm（Zheng et al., 2025）为这种潜在思维交换提供了可识别性保证。 另一条研究路线针对具有不同架构和词表的异构LLM：Interlat（Du et al., 2025）学习跨架构的压缩适配器以大幅提升推理速度，C2C（Zhang et al., 2025）通过学习到的门控机制在Qwen、Llama和Gemma之间融合KV缓存，而Dery et al. （2026）本着同样的精神学习KV缓存对齐适配器，SDE（Tang et al., 2025）采取混合立场，用隐藏状态增量来增强文本，而Vision Wormhole（Liu and others, 2026）通过接收方的视觉标记通路在VLM之间传递推理轨迹。 这些方法都没有解决从VLM到纯文本SLM的迁移问题，而这正是本文所研究的场景。 此外，这些方法没有将发送方的深度层级作为结构化信号加以利用。 隐藏状态方法只交换单个transformer层，而KV缓存方法虽然覆盖所有层，但只是对其进行统一池化或对齐，并没有区分深度的抽象层次。 最后，尽管多深度结构已在单个模型内部被探索过——例如LLaMA-Adapter（Zhang et al., 2023）在单个VLM的多个transformer深度处插入带门控的视觉残差——但跨两个独立模型的多深度迁移尚未被探索。

paragraphs.en: We introduce Latent-Lens , a latent-communication codec that passes visual information from a frozen VLM to a separately pretrained text-only SLM.
paragraphs.zh: 我们介绍 Latent-Lens，这是一种潜在通信编解码器，可将视觉信息从冻结的 VLM 传递到单独预训练的纯文本 SLM。

paragraphs.en: Unlike prior inter-model latent methods that exchange a single transformer layer’s representation, Latent-Lens extracts from multiple semantic depth bands of the sender VLM, preserving its perceptual hierarchy.
paragraphs.zh: 与以往仅交换单个 transformer 层表示的模型间潜空间方法不同，Latent-Lens 从发送方 VLM 的多个语义深度带中提取信息，以保留其感知层次结构。

paragraphs.en: Trained on only 1.6M parameters (0.2% of the frozen pair), Latent-Lens outperforms text-communication baselines on image-understanding tasks requiring fine-grained visual perception (VQA, captioning), and generalises to alternative SLM and VLM backbone combinations.
paragraphs.zh: Latent-Lens 仅使用 160 万参数（冻结参数对的 0.2%）进行训练，在需要细粒度视觉感知的图像理解任务（VQA、描述生成）上超越了基于文本通信的基线方法，并可泛化到其他 SLM 与 VLM 主干网络组合。

paragraphs.en: The default set of models used here are SmolVLM-256M ( HuggingFace, 2024 ) ( L V = 30 L_{V}=30 , d V = 576 d_{V}=576 , 256M params) as the VLM agent and Qwen2.5-0.5B ( Alibaba Cloud, 2024 ) ( L S = 24 L_{S}=24 , d S = 896 d_{S}=896 , 500M params) as the SLM agent. paragraphs.en: For VQA we use free-form answer generation and compare predictions to ground truth with a normalized containment heuristic. We lowercase the prediction and reference, remove articles and punctuation, normalize whitespace, and convert number words to digits. We accept an exact match or a match in which every word in the shorter answer appears in the longer answer. Multiple-choice formatting with random distractors inflated SLM-only GQA accuracy in preliminary experiments, motivating the switch to free-form generation as a stricter test of visual understanding. Captioning on Flickr8k is evaluated with BLEU-4 against the reference captions.
paragraphs.zh: 对于VQA，我们采用自由形式的答案生成，并通过一种归一化包含启发式方法将预测与真实答案进行比较。 我们将预测和参考答案转为小写，去除冠词和标点符号，规范空白字符，并将数字单词转换为数字。 我们接受完全匹配，或者接受较短答案中的每个单词都出现在较长答案中的匹配。 使用随机干扰项的多选题格式在初步实验中夸大了仅使用小型语言模型（SLM）的GQA准确率，这促使我们改用自由形式生成作为对视觉理解更严格的测试。 Flickr8k上的图像描述任务使用BLEU-4对照参考描述进行评估。

paragraphs.en: (1) VLM-only (frozen) : SmolVLM-256M ( HuggingFace, 2024 ) generates directly from the image and question. (2) SLM-only (frozen) : Qwen2.5-0.5B ( Alibaba Cloud, 2024 ) with no trainable parameters, text input only. (3) Text communication (frozen) : the VLM produces a textual response to the question, which is prepended to the frozen SLM prompt. (4) SLM-only + LoRA : same as (2) with 0.3M LoRA ( Hu et al., 2022 ) parameters (rank 4). (5) Text communication + LoRA : same as (3) with the same 0.3M rank-4 Q/V LoRA used by Latent-Lens. (6) LLaMA-Adapter ( Zhang et al., 2023 ) : deeper-injection baseline that uses the same shared VLM → \to SLM projection as our method but additionally injects gated visual residuals at each of the top-12 SLM layers, with a total trainable budget matched to ours (1.6M). (7) Latent-Lens : our method (1.6M params: 1.3M projection + 0.3M rank-4 Q/V LoRA). The +LoRA variants isolate the effect of the communication channel from task adaptation by giving the SLM the same LoRA budget as in our method, while the LLaMA-Adapter baseline contrasts our input-prefix + LoRA design against layer-wise gated-residual injection at matched parameter budget.

paragraphs.en: We first establish a floor by evaluating each component in isolation. The frozen SLM reaches 1.5%, 18.0%, and 11.8 BLEU-4 on CLEVR, GQA, and Flickr8k, respectively. The VLM in isolation reaches 58.6%, 41.8%, and 13.9 BLEU-4 on CLEVR, GQA, and Flickr8k, respectively. Prepending VLM-generated text responses to the frozen SLM (text communication, frozen) yields 11.2%, 35.2%, and 0.1 BLEU-4 on CLEVR, GQA, and Flickr8k, respectively. Latent-Lens reaches 81.0 ± 7.9 81.0\pm 7.9 %, 65.4 ± 5.4 65.4\pm 5.4 %, and 18.9 ± 1.0 18.9\pm 1.0 BLEU-4 on CLEVR, GQA, and Flickr8k, respectively, exceeding frozen text communication by +69.8pp, +30.2pp, and +18.8 BLEU-4. The two VQA scores under text communication remain well below VLM-only direct generation, indicating that the text channel does not preserve the visual information available to the VLM internally.

paragraphs.en: We compare Latent-Lens against LLaMA-Adapter ( Zhang et al., 2023 ) , an alternative method for conditioning a frozen language model on projected visual features through gated prompts attended at the upper transformer layers. In our adaptation we retain the shared VLM → \to SLM projection and replace only the input-prefix + LoRA Q/V adaptation with the LLaMA-Adapter mechanism at the top-12 SLM layers, under a matched 1.6M trainable parameter budget. The baseline reaches 73.6 ± 3.5 73.6\pm 3.5 %, 61.9 ± 6.1 61.9\pm 6.1 %, and 18.0 ± 0.7 18.0\pm 0.7 BLEU-4 on CLEVR, GQA, and Flickr8k, respectively, against 81.0 ± 7.9 81.0\pm 7.9 %, 65.4 ± 5.4 65.4\pm 5.4 %, and 18.9 ± 1.0 18.9\pm 1.0 for Latent-Lens. We attribute the gap to where the visual signal enters the SLM. LLaMA-Adapter introduces visual context only at the upper transformer layers, so the lower-layer text representations are computed without it. Latent-Lens injects the visual prefix at the input embedding, and all subsequent layers compute over visually-conditioned text representations through the SLM’s pre-trained self-attention.

paragraphs.en: CLEVR isolates spatial relations, counting, and attribute recognition over synthetic 3D scenes, where the latent channel was expected to separate most clearly from text since fine-grained structured visual content is hardest to verbalise. Latent-Lens achieves 81.0 ± 7.9 81.0\pm 7.9 %, compared with 58.3 ± 5.7 58.3\pm 5.7 % for text communication + LoRA. GQA contains compositional questions over real photographs, on which language priors and short descriptions are expected to carry more signal than on CLEVR. Latent-Lens achieves 65.4 ± 5.4 65.4\pm 5.4 %, compared with 61.8 ± 1.0 61.8\pm 1.0 % for text communication + LoRA, with SLM+LoRA ( 46.2 ± 1.3 46.2\pm 1.3 %) only modestly above VLM-only (41.8%), consistent with the partial sufficiency of text-based reasoning at this benchmark. Flickr8k is an open-ended captioning task that allows the VLM to emit substantially richer text than the terse VQA answers, which we hypothesised would narrow the gap between Latent-Lens and VLM-only generation. The VLM produces 40.6-word descriptions on average against 1.0 and 1.1 words on CLEVR and GQA, and the +5.0 BLEU-4 margin of Latent-Lens over VLM-only is the smallest in our experiments, consistent with this hypothesis. To examine whether the observed captioning improvement extends beyond BLEU-4, we rescore the saved captions from Latent-Lens and text communication + LoRA on a diagnostic 200-example Flickr8k subset using CIDEr ( Vedantam et al., 2015 ) , obtaining 0.0587 and 0.0215, respectively.

paragraphs.en: To test generality across heterogeneous backbones, we evaluate Latent-Lens on all four pairings of two VLMs (SmolVLM-256M, InternVL2-1B) and two SLMs (Qwen2.5-0.5B, TinyLlama-1.1B). The Flickr8k scores additionally reflect the SLM’s text-only fit to the caption distribution, since TinyLlama-1.1B reaches 27.1 BLEU-4 with no visual input against 11.7 for Qwen2.5-0.5B, which is why the TinyLlama pairings reach higher Flickr8k scores. paragraphs.en: We introduced Latent-Lens , a lightweight cross-modal codec that adds visual perception to a frozen text-only small language model. Where prior multi-agent VLM-SLM systems use natural language as the inter-model channel, Latent-Lens routes the VLM’s hidden states directly into the SLM and transmits visual content as a continuous representation rather than a short token description. Discrete text irrecoverably discards spatial layout and fine-grained perceptual attributes that the VLM has already encoded internally, while the latent channel preserves them. The increased expressiveness translates into higher downstream accuracy than text communication at the same parameter budget. Replacing autoregressive image-to-text generation with a single VLM forward pass also keeps the latency overhead over the SLM-only baseline small, so the SLM gains visual perception without paying the cost of describing the image in words. Note however that these opaque messages are harder to inspect and audit compared to text communication. The codec leaves both backbones untouched and transfers across heterogeneous VLM and SLM families with different vocabularies and hidden dimensions. Finally, our experiments are limited to communication between two agents and do not evaluate larger multi-agent systems and the band-count ablation shows that no single value of B B performs best across all tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 Latent-Lens，这是一种轻量级跨模态编解码器，可为冻结的纯文本小语言模型添加视觉感知能力。 先前的多智能体 VLM-SLM 系统使用自然语言作为模型间通道，而 Latent-Lens 则将 VLM 的隐藏状态直接路由到 SLM 中，并以连续表示而非简短的 token 描述来传输视觉内容。 离散文本会不可逆地丢弃 VLM 已在内部编码的空间布局和细粒度感知属性，而潜在通道则能保留这些信息。 这种更强的表达能力转化为更高的下游准确率，在相同参数预算下优于文本通信。 用单次 VLM 前向传播替代自回归的图像到文本生成，还将相对于仅 SLM 基线的延迟开销保持在较低水平，使 SLM 无需付出用文字描述图像的代价即可获得视觉感知能力。 然而需要注意的是，与文本通信相比，这些不透明的消息更难检查和审计。 该编解码器不改动两个骨干模型，并能跨具有不同词表和隐藏维度的异构 VLM 与 SLM 家族进行迁移。 最后，我们的实验仅限于两个智能体之间的通信，未评估更大规模的多智能体系统，且通道数消融实验表明，没有任何单一的 B B 值能在所有任务上表现最佳。

paragraphs.en: Several extensions are natural follow-ups. The current design uses uniform band partitions over the VLM’s depth, so learned or adaptive band boundaries (e.g., MoE-style differentiable routing over depth) are a promising direction. Communication is unidirectional in this work, while bidirectional or multi-turn latent dialogue, in which the SLM can request clarification and the VLM can revise its prefix accordingly, is a natural next step. Broader evaluation across other vision-language tasks (visual grounding, fine-grained recognition) and integration with KV-cache alignment on the language side ( Dery et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) would further stress-test and extend the approach.

paragraphs.en: Free-form answers are compared via a normalised string match. The prediction and the reference are lowercased, stripped of leading articles (a, an, the) and punctuation, and number words are mapped to digits (e.g., “three” → \to “3”). A prediction is accepted on either an exact match against the reference or bidirectional word-set containment, where every word in the shorter answer appears in the longer one. The metric was validated against 50 hand-labelled CLEVR and GQA examples with 100% agreement.
paragraphs.zh: 自由格式的答案通过规范化后的字符串匹配进行比较。 预测答案和参考答案会被转为小写，去除开头的冠词（a、an、the）和标点符号，并将数字单词映射为数字（例如，“three” → “3”）。 只要预测答案与参考答案完全匹配，或满足双向词集包含关系（即较短答案中的每个词都出现在较长答案中），即视为通过。 该指标在 50 个人工标注的 CLEVR 和 GQA 样例上进行了验证，一致率达到 100%。

paragraphs.en: Tables 8 , 9 and 10 show real samples from CLEVR, GQA, and Flickr8k, comparing what each condition receives. paragraphs.en: On VQA, VLM responses are strikingly terse: single numbers or words that discard all spatial, relational, and attribute information present in the image. On CLEVR, the VLM attempts to answer counting and comparison questions with a single digit, often incorrectly (e.g., “1” instead of “2”, “7” instead of “8”). On GQA, responses are typically “Yes”, “No”, or a single noun. The SLM in text communication mode receives only this minimal signal and cannot recover information the VLM failed to verbalise. On Flickr8k captioning the failure mode is the opposite: the VLM produces 40+ word narrative descriptions which carry richer surface content but in a register that does not match the short, declarative reference captions, and which routinely hallucinate specific details (jersey number, “river in the background”). When this verbose response is inserted into the text-communication SLM prompt, it both biases the SLM toward narration and injects the hallucinated content as “ground truth”, causing the BLEU-4 collapse to 2.4 ± 2.0 2.4\pm 2.0 reported in Table 1 . The latent channel, by contrast, transmits the VLM’s full internal representation with hundreds of effective dimensions per band, preserving information that the VLM encodes internally but cannot express faithfully in tokens, whether terse or verbose.
paragraphs.zh: 在 VQA 上，VLM 的回答极其简短：仅是单个数字或单词，丢弃了图像中全部的空间、关系和属性信息。 在 CLEVR 上，VLM 试图用单个数字回答计数和比较问题，且经常出错（例如，用「1」代替「2」，用「7」代替「8」）。 在 GQA 上，回答通常是「Yes」「No」或单个名词。 文本通信模式下的 SLM 只接收到这一极简信号，无法恢复 VLM 未能用言语表达的信息。 在 Flickr8k 图像描述任务上，失败模式则相反：VLM 生成 40 多个单词的叙述性描述，这些描述包含更丰富的表面内容，但其语体与简短、陈述式的参考描述不匹配，并且经常幻觉出具体细节（球衣号码、「背景中的河流」）。 当这一冗长回答被插入文本通信 SLM 的提示词中时，它既使 SLM 偏向叙述，又将幻觉内容作为「事实依据」注入，导致表 1 中报告的 BLEU-4 崩溃至 2.4 ± 2.0 2.4\pm 2.0 。 相比之下，潜在通道以每个频带数百个有效维度传输 VLM 的完整内部表示，保留了 VLM 内部编码但无法用 token 忠实表达的信息，无论这些 token 是简短还是冗长。
